changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "log".one_id_log ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4 ( ) NOT NULL, user_id UUID, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, company_id UUID, request_time TIMESTAMP , created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
